note: Aubade's lobby JIT-compiles its shader on SwiftShader and missed the e2e time budget (LOBBY_TIMEOUT): CI is 3-5x slower than a local run. Fixed by raising the budget in e2e/support/lobby.ts. FLAG: arguably environment (runner speed), and for runs right after a shader change possibly regression. Lower confidence: a different test, same fix.
